incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0: Styx Enterprise (VPC: styx-prod, region: eu-west-2) p99 latency spike detected on dedicated pool 'styx-dedicated-01' — paging SRE and Customer Success. Trace id: rdx-1779012345

sre-oncall: joining — saw the page, hopping into warroom. who has runbook for tenant isolation here?

Elaine: grabbing dashboards. p95 jumped from ~140ms -> ~2.4s; p99 up to 6s. QPS steady, but tail tokens/s per request increased. Top offender tenant_id=styx-12345 (high concat seqs). KV cache miss rate for that pool is 18% (baseline 2%).

Mike: stack traces look like KV cache thrashing + long decode on quantized layer. I've repro'd a couple slow traces — KV fetchs timing out ~800ms in some pods.

Tara: Styx-ops just DM'd: "users seeing timeouts on generation, some API errors 504s" — customer-facing impact confirmed. they're asking for ETA.

Kenji: marking this customer as enterprise + dedicated. Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) isolate tenant traffic off the dedicated pool to a hosted fallback route, 2) trigger eviction/reshuffle of noisy pods in the pool, 3) enable aggressive prefix cache for that tenant. Which is fastest?

Elaine: fastest is route-level isolation (routing policy). I can push a traffic rule to move styx-12345 to fallback variants with lower throughput but lower tail. Doing it now.

Mike: I'll prepare warm failover of fallback model variant (smaller context, lower KV needs). Running deploy command to warm replicas:
```
rdxctl deploy --pool hosted-fallback-eu --model redwood-v1-small --replicas 4 --tag styx-fallback-177901
```
Starting now, warming should be up in ~120s.

Elaine: applying route override:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/styx-prod
{ "match": "tenant_id:styx-12345", "route_to": "styx-fallback-177901" }
```
Applied — traffic should start shifting in ~30s. Monitoring logs.

incident-bot: Action recorded: route override applied by Elaine, warm failover started by Mike, customer notified by Tara. Incident channel created: #warroom-styx-1779012345.

Lucas: I'll own customer comms. Tara, suggest: "We've identified unusual request shapes from a single tenant causing elevated tail latency. We've implemented a temporary routing fallback to restore performance; investigating root cause. ETA ~30m for stabilization." Ok?

Tara: yup sending now.

Styx-ops: Confirmed they see reduced errors after ~40s, but some sessions still slow. Asking for confirmation on whether any data or outputs were lost.

Elaine: no data lost; fallback uses same model with constrained context size — outputs preserved but some long-context generation may truncate. Sending internal note to CS.

Mike: eviction run on dedicated pool started to remove pods with repeated KV timeouts:
```
rdxctl pool evict --pool styx-dedicated-01 --selector "kv_timeout>500" --grace 10s
```
Evictions happening, new pods being scheduled.

Kenji: while evictions complete, can we also temporarily reduce concurrency limit for that dedicated pool to reduce KV contention?

Elaine: lowering max_concurrency from 32 -> 8 for styx-dedicated-01 now.

incident-bot: Config change recorded: max_concurrency lowered by Elaine. Performance metrics will update in ~60s.

sre-oncall: handing off active mitigation list to Kenji in 20m (oncall rotation). Kenji please confirm you'll take point for postmortem.

Kenji: copying. I'll continue root-cause after handoff and own the postmortem.

Lucas: sent customer update: "short-term mitigation in place, visible improvement; engineering performing deeper investigation. We'll follow up with RCA and any compensating actions." Customer replies :thumbsup:.

Mike: warm fallback pool healthy, QPS shifted ~18% of traffic off dedicated pool. p95 now ~220ms, p99 ~480ms for customer overall — still above target but much better.

Elaine: KV miss rate on dedicated pool dropping back toward baseline as eviction and concurrency changes take effect. Looks like noisy long-context requests were causing cache churn.

Tara: support will keep monitoring and update Styx if anything changes. Preparing post-incident checklist: timeline, config diffs, tenant request samples, traces.

incident-bot: Summary snapshot: 1) Detection: p99 spike 1779012345, 2) Mitigation: route override -> fallback, pool evictions, concurrency cap, 3) Impact: Styx users saw errors/timeouts for ~5-10m before mitigation, degraded SLO for p99 during window, no data loss, 4) Owner: Kenji (RCA/postmortem).

sre-oncall: closing out warroom for now; Kenji please create postmortem doc and link to this thread. If anything regresses, re-open. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Kenji: will file RCA and include recommended long-term fixes: request-size throttles per tenant, smarter KV eviction policy, and routing policy auto-fallback thresholds.

Styx-ops: thanks for fast response. We'll coordinate on any behavioral changes on our side.

Lucas: marking customer success follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident closed by sre-oncall. Duration: ~00:32:35. Tags: customer-impact, dedicated-pool, tenant-isolation.
